segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin describe the cream as lightweight and gel-like, saying it hydrates without adding shine and keeps oil in check through the day, though one notes light oiliness in the T-zone after a few hours.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report meaningful relief from dryness and winter tightness, though a couple say the formula is too light and needs layering with a heavier product for full moisture.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as balancing, controlling shine in the T-zone while still relieving dry or flaky patches on the cheeks.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly call it gentle, fragrance-free and calming, with several praising it for reducing flare-ups and redness, but one sensitive-skin reviewer reports itchy bumps and breakouts after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions using it on damaged, discolored skin and felt it helped soften texture and discoloration, but there is little further material specific to mature skin.

concerns.aging: There is minimal direct comment on aging; one reviewer felt it softened the appearance of skin discoloration and roughness, but no reviewer speaks explicitly about wrinkles or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dehydration report noticeable, often immediate improvement in hydration and plumpness that some say lasts all day; one reviewer says it did not really hydrate her skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the cream visibly reduced redness and calmed irritated or flare-prone skin, including after chemical peels or psoriasis flares; one reviewer with inflammation-focused concerns saw no noticeable difference.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the cream with repairing or strengthening a compromised skin barrier over days to weeks, describing relief after burning sensations from other products.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers with dry patches or discoloration near the nose and chin report the patches disappearing after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some even clearer skin, including one describing clearing of acne within two days; however, two reviewers describe worsened breakouts and itchy bumps after use.
concerns.oiliness: Most oily-skin reviewers say the cream keeps oil at bay and doesn't feel greasy, though one reviewer noted her T-zone felt oily a few hours after application.
